mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 77 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park, and we are under an air quality alert with an index of 60.

City officials are planning road improvements on Highway M starting August 18, which will impact traffic flow near the Alliant and Kwik Trip driveway. Additionally, the City Council is reviewing upcoming development projects including a new site plan for 201 South Main Street.

There is plenty to do in town today with trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or enjoy music and yoga sessions around the city.
Looking at the weekly report, on Saturday, August 8, local officers apprehended two juveniles for underage drinking and curfew violations on Barbara Street.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch, and you have until 10 PM to grab some. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor.
